  firstly, the elementary computation that `deriv f (n + 1) = deriv f n + 1 / n`, so that
  `deriv f n = deriv f 1 + harmonic n`; secondly, the convexity of `f` (the Bohr-Mollerup theorem),
  which shows that `deriv f n` is `log n + o(1)` as `n → ∞`. -/
  let f := log ∘ Gamma
  -- First reduce to computing derivative of `log ∘ Gamma`.
  suffices deriv (log ∘ Gamma) (n + 1) = -γ + harmonic n by
    rwa [Function.comp_def, deriv.log (differentiableAt_Gamma (fun m ↦ by linarith))
      (by positivity), Gamma_nat_eq_factorial, div_eq_iff_mul_eq (by positivity),
      mul_comm, Eq.comm] at this
  have hc : ConvexOn ℝ (Ioi 0) f := convexOn_log_Gamma

      Gamma_add_one hx.ne', log_mul hx.ne' (Gamma_pos_of_pos hx).ne', add_comm]
  have hder {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x := by
    refine ((differentiableAt_Gamma ?_).log (Gamma_ne_zero ?_)) <;>
    exact fun m ↦ ne_of_gt (by linarith)
  -- Express derivative at general `n` in terms of value at `1` using recurrence relation
  have hder_rec (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) : deriv f (x + 1) = deriv f x + 1 / x := by
    rw [← deriv_comp_add_const, one_div, ← deriv_log,
      ← deriv_add (hder <| by positivity) (differentiableAt_log hx.ne')]
    apply EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_nhds hx] using h_rec
  have hder_nat (n : ℕ) : deriv f (n + 1) = deriv f 1 + harmonic n := by
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n hn =>
      rw [cast_succ, hder_rec (n + 1) (by positivity), hn, harmonic_succ]
      push_cast
      ring
  suffices -deriv f 1 = γ by rw [hder_nat n, ← this, neg_neg]
  -- Use convexity to show derivative of `f` at `n + 1` is between `log n` and `log (n + 1)`

    refine (le_of_eq ?_).trans <| hc.slope_le_deriv (mem_Ioi.mpr <| Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn)
      (by positivity : _ < (_ : ℝ)) (by linarith) (hder <| by positivity)
    rw [slope_def_field, show n + 1 - n = (1 : ℝ) by ring, div_one, h_rec n (by positivity),
      add_sub_cancel_left]
  have derivUB (n : ℕ) : deriv f (n + 1) ≤ log (n + 1) := by
    refine (hc.deriv_le_slope (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < n + 1) (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < n + 2)
        (by linarith) (hder <| by positivity)).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [slope_def_field, show n + 2 - (n + 1) = (1 : ℝ) by ring, div_one,
      show n + 2 = (n + 1) + (1 : ℝ) by ring, h_rec (n + 1) (by positivity), add_sub_cancel_left]
  -- deduce `-deriv f 1` is bounded above + below by sequences which both tend to `γ`
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply ge_of_tendsto tendsto_harmonic_sub_log
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn
    rw [le_sub_iff_add_le', ← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_le_iff_le_add', ← hder_nat]
    exact derivLB n hn
  · apply le_of_tendsto tendsto_harmonic_sub_log_add_one
    filter_upwards with n
    rw [sub_le_iff_le_add', ← sub_eq_add_neg, le_sub_iff_add_le', ← hder_nat]
    exact derivUB n

      1 / 2 + alpha < sigma → sigma ≤ 9 / 8 →

      1 / 2 + alpha < sigma → sigma ≤ 9 / 8 →

by
  obtain ⟨D, hD0, hdata⟩ := exists_crit_landau_data
  obtain ⟨E, hE0, hcount⟩ := exists_crit_zero_count
  refine ⟨D + 50 * D + 50 * (8 + E), by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro sigma gamma hgamma hsigma0 hsigma1
  have hgamma0 : (0 : ℝ) < |gamma| := by linarith
  have hloggamma : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log |gamma| := by
    have he : Real.exp 1 < 7 := by
      have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
      linarith
    have h := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) (by linarith : Real.exp 1 ≤ |gamma|)
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at h
  have hgammanz : gamma ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hgamma
    norm_num at hgamma
  set z : ℂ := (sigma : ℂ) + (gamma : ℂ) * Complex.I with hzdef
  have hzre : z.re = sigma := by rw [hzdef]; simp
  have hzim : z.im = gamma := by rw [hzdef]; simp
  have hzc : ‖z - critCentre gamma‖ ≤ 5 / 8 := by
    have hdiff : z - critCentre gamma = (((sigma - 9 / 8 : ℝ)) : ℂ) := by
      rw [hzdef, critCentre]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hdiff, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hzne : riemannZeta z ≠ 0 := by
    apply riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_xiZeroHalfPlaneBound halpha hXi
    rw [hzre]
    exact hsigma0
  obtain ⟨Z, m, h1, h2, _h3, _h4, h5⟩ := hdata gamma hgamma
  have hkeyc : ‖logDeriv riemannZeta (critCentre gamma)
      - ∑ rho ∈ Z, (m rho : ℂ) / (critCentre gamma - rho)‖ ≤ D * Real.log |gamma| := by
    refine h5 (critCentre gamma) (by rw [sub_self, norm_zero]; norm_num) ?_
    exact zeta_critCentre_ne_zero gamma
  have hcnt := hcount gamma hgamma Z m D h1 h2 hkeyc
  have hdist : ∀ rho ∈ Z, sigma - (1 / 2 + alpha) ≤ ‖z - rho‖ := by
    intro rho hrho
    have hrhoim : rho.im ≠ 0 := by
      have hd : |rho.im - gamma| ≤ ‖rho - critCentre gamma‖ := by
        have h := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (rho - critCentre gamma)
        rwa [Complex.sub_im, critCentre_im] at h
      have hb := h1 rho hrho
      intro hcon
      rw [hcon] at hd
      simp only [zero_sub, abs_neg] at hd
      linarith
    have hre := riemannZeta_zero_re_le_of_xiZeroHalfPlaneBound hXi (h2 rho hrho) hrhoim
    have h := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (z - rho)
    rw [Complex.sub_re, hzre] at h
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ sigma - rho.re := by linarith
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hnonneg] at h
    linarith
  have hsum : ‖∑ rho ∈ Z, (m rho : ℂ) / (z - rho)‖
      ≤ (∑ rho ∈ Z, (m rho : ℝ)) / (sigma - (1 / 2 + alpha)) := by
    refine le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _) ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun rho hrho => ?_
    rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_natCast]
    have hd := hdist rho hrho
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < sigma - (1 / 2 + alpha) := by linarith
    have hzr : (0 : ℝ) < ‖z - rho‖ := by linarith
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hzr hpos]
    have hm0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (m rho : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    nlinarith [hd, hm0]
  have hkeyz := h5 z hzc hzne
  have hsplit : ‖logDeriv riemannZeta z‖
      ≤ ‖logDeriv riemannZeta z - ∑ rho ∈ Z, (m rho : ℂ) / (z - rho)‖
        + ‖∑ rho ∈ Z, (m rho : ℂ) / (z - rho)‖ := by
    simpa using norm_add_le
      (logDeriv riemannZeta z - ∑ rho ∈ Z, (m rho : ℂ) / (z - rho))
      (∑ rho ∈ Z, (m rho : ℂ) / (z - rho))
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < sigma - (1 / 2 + alpha) := by linarith
  have hdelta1 : sigma - (1 / 2 + alpha) ≤ 1 := by linarith
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hpos]
  have hsumb : (∑ rho ∈ Z, (m rho : ℝ)) / (sigma - (1 / 2 + alpha))
      ≤ (50 * (D * Real.log |gamma|) + 50 * (8 + E)) /
        (sigma - (1 / 2 + alpha)) := by gcongr
  have hchain : ‖logDeriv riemannZeta z‖
      ≤ D * Real.log |gamma| +
        (50 * (D * Real.log |gamma|) + 50 * (8 + E)) /
          (sigma - (1 / 2 + alpha)) := by
    linarith [hsplit, hkeyz, hsum, hsumb]
  have hmul : ‖logDeriv riemannZeta z‖ * (sigma - (1 / 2 + alpha))
      ≤ (D * Real.log |gamma| +
          (50 * (D * Real.log |gamma|) + 50 * (8 + E)) /
            (sigma - (1 / 2 + alpha))) * (sigma - (1 / 2 + alpha)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hchain hpos.le
  have hid : (D * Real.log |gamma| +
        (50 * (D * Real.log |gamma|) + 50 * (8 + E)) /
          (sigma - (1 / 2 + alpha))) * (sigma - (1 / 2 + alpha))
      = D * Real.log |gamma| * (sigma - (1 / 2 + alpha)) +
        (50 * (D * Real.log |gamma|) + 50 * (8 + E)) := by
    rw [add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hpos.ne']
  rw [hid] at hmul
  refine hmul.trans ?_
  nlinarith [hloggamma, hD0, hE0, hdelta1, hpos,

theorem exists_pseudoInverse_of_gap [CompleteSpace E]
    {T : E →L[𝕜] E} {ψ₀ : E} {γ : ℝ}
    (hsymm : ∀ u v : E, ⟪T u, v⟫_𝕜 = ⟪u, T v⟫_𝕜)
    (hTψ : T ψ₀ = 0) (hnorm : ⟪ψ₀, ψ₀⟫_𝕜 = 1)
    (hker : ∀ φ : E, T φ = 0 → ∃ s : 𝕜, φ = s • ψ₀)
    (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hgap : ∀ φ : E, ⟪ψ₀, φ⟫_𝕜 = 0 → γ * ‖φ‖ ≤ ‖T φ‖) :
    ∃ R : E →L[𝕜] E, (∀ y : E, T (R y) = y - ⟪ψ₀, y⟫_𝕜 • ψ₀) ∧ (∀ y : E, ⟪ψ₀, R y⟫_𝕜 = 0)

theorem exists_pseudoInverse_of_gap [CompleteSpace E]
    {T : E →L[𝕜] E} {ψ₀ : E} {γ : ℝ}
    (hsymm : ∀ u v : E, ⟪T u, v⟫_𝕜 = ⟪u, T v⟫_𝕜)
    (hTψ : T ψ₀ = 0) (hnorm : ⟪ψ₀, ψ₀⟫_𝕜 = 1)
    (hker : ∀ φ : E, T φ = 0 → ∃ s : 𝕜, φ = s • ψ₀)
    (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hgap : ∀ φ : E, ⟪ψ₀, φ⟫_𝕜 = 0 → γ * ‖φ‖ ≤ ‖T φ‖) :
    ∃ R : E →L[𝕜] E, (∀ y : E, T (R y) = y - ⟪ψ₀, y⟫_𝕜 • ψ₀) ∧ (∀ y : E, ⟪ψ₀, R y⟫_𝕜 = 0)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  classical
  set W : Submodule 𝕜 E := (𝕜 ∙ ψ₀)ᗮ with hWdef
  have hmemW : ∀ x : E, x ∈ W ↔ ⟪ψ₀, x⟫_𝕜 = 0 := fun x =>
    Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right
  haveI hWc : CompleteSpace W := (Submodule.isClosed_orthogonal _).completeSpace_coe
  have hperpRange : ∀ z : E, ⟪ψ₀, T z⟫_𝕜 = 0 := by
    intro z
    have h := hsymm ψ₀ z
    rw [hTψ, inner_zero_left] at h
    exact h.symm
  obtain ⟨TW, hTWcoe⟩ := gapRestrict hsymm hTψ
  -- a transverse vector in the kernel is zero
  have hWzero : ∀ x : W, T (x : E) = 0 → x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hker _ hx
    have hxW : ⟪ψ₀, (x : E)⟫_𝕜 = 0 := (hmemW _).1 x.2
    rw [hs, inner_smul_right, hnorm, mul_one] at hxW
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    rw [hs, hxW, zero_smul]
    rfl
  have hinj : LinearMap.ker (TW : W →ₗ[𝕜] W) = ⊥ := by
    rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
    intro x hx
    refine hWzero x ?_
    rw [← hTWcoe x]
    have h : TW x = 0 := hx
    rw [h]
    rfl
  -- the gap makes the restriction bounded below, so its range is closed
  have hbound : ∀ x : W, ‖x‖ ≤ γ⁻¹ * ‖TW x‖ := by
    intro x
    have h := hgap (x : E) ((hmemW _).1 x.2)
    have hn : ‖TW x‖ = ‖T (x : E)‖ := by rw [← hTWcoe x]; rfl
    have hnx : ‖x‖ = ‖(x : E)‖ := rfl
    rw [hn, hnx, inv_mul_eq_div, le_div_iff₀ hγ, mul_comm]
    exact h
  have hclosedRange : IsClosed (Set.range TW) := by
    have hanti : AntilipschitzWith ⟨γ⁻¹, (inv_pos.mpr hγ).le⟩ (TW) :=
      TW.antilipschitz_of_bound hbound
    exact hanti.isClosed_range TW.lipschitz.uniformContinuous
  have hKclosed : IsClosed ((LinearMap.range (TW : W →ₗ[𝕜] W) : Submodule 𝕜 W) : Set W) := by
    convert hclosedRange using 1
    ext z
    simp [LinearMap.mem_range]
  haveI : CompleteSpace (LinearMap.range (TW : W →ₗ[𝕜] W)) := hKclosed.completeSpace_coe
  haveI : (LinearMap.range (TW : W →ₗ[𝕜] W)).HasOrthogonalProjection :=
    Submodule.HasOrthogonalProjection.ofCompleteSpace _
  -- and dense: a transverse vector orthogonal to the range is killed by `T`
  have hKperp : (LinearMap.range (TW : W →ₗ[𝕜] W))ᗮ = ⊥ := by
    rw [Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
    intro y hy
    have hy' : ∀ x : W, ⟪T (x : E), (y : E)⟫_𝕜 = 0 := by
      intro x
      have h := hy (TW x) (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ x)
      rw [Submodule.coe_inner, hTWcoe] at h
      exact h
    have hTy : ∀ z : E, ⟪z, T (y : E)⟫_𝕜 = 0 := by
      intro z
      have hz : z - ⟪ψ₀, z⟫_𝕜 • ψ₀ ∈ W := by
        rw [hmemW, inner_sub_right, inner_smul_right, hnorm, mul_one, sub_self]
      have h1 : ⟪z - ⟪ψ₀, z⟫_𝕜 • ψ₀, T (y : E)⟫_𝕜 = 0 := by
        have h := hy' ⟨z - ⟪ψ₀, z⟫_𝕜 • ψ₀, hz⟩
        rw [hsymm] at h
        exact h
      have h2 : ⟪(⟪ψ₀, z⟫_𝕜 : 𝕜) • ψ₀, T (y : E)⟫_𝕜 = 0 := by
        rw [inner_smul_left, hperpRange, mul_zero]
      have hsplit : ⟪z, T (y : E)⟫_𝕜
          = ⟪z - ⟪ψ₀, z⟫_𝕜 • ψ₀, T (y : E)⟫_𝕜 + ⟪(⟪ψ₀, z⟫_𝕜 : 𝕜) • ψ₀, T (y : E)⟫_𝕜 := by
        rw [inner_sub_left]; ring
      rw [hsplit, h1, h2, add_zero]
    exact hWzero y (inner_self_eq_zero.mp (hTy (T (y : E))))
  have hsurj : LinearMap.range (TW : W →ₗ[𝕜] W) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← Submodule.orthogonal_eq_bot_iff]
    exact hKperp
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : W →L[𝕜] W, ∀ x : W, TW (S x) = x := by
    refine ⟨((ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective TW hinj hsurj).symm : W →L[𝕜] W), fun x => ?_⟩
    have h1 : ((ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective TW hinj hsurj : W ≃L[𝕜] W) : W →L[𝕜] W) = TW :=
      ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_ofBijective _ _ _
    have h3 : ∀ z : W, (ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective TW hinj hsurj) z = TW z :=
      fun z => congrArg (fun g : W →L[𝕜] W => g z) h1
    exact (h3 _).symm.trans (ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _)
  obtain ⟨Pw, hPw⟩ : ∃ f : E →L[𝕜] W, ∀ y : E, ((f y : E)) = y - ⟪ψ₀, y⟫_𝕜 • ψ₀ := by
    refine ⟨(ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 E - (innerSL 𝕜 ψ₀).smulRight ψ₀).codRestrict W ?_,
      fun _ => rfl⟩
    intro y
    rw [hmemW]
    show ⟪ψ₀, y - ⟪ψ₀, y⟫_𝕜 • ψ₀⟫_𝕜 = 0
    rw [inner_sub_right, inner_smul_right, hnorm, mul_one, sub_self]
  refine ⟨(Submodule.subtypeL W).comp (S.comp Pw), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y
    show T ((S (Pw y) : E)) = y - ⟪ψ₀, y⟫_𝕜 • ψ₀
    rw [← hTWcoe (S (Pw y)), hS, hPw]
  · intro y
    exact (hmemW _).1 (S (Pw y)).2
